name: MeJUICEa
review:
A fruit cluster game on 6x5 with avalanches, a global multiplier and a Crush mechanic that smashes winning fruit to make bigger wins.

The Crush is the hook: smashed fruit makes room for the next cascade while the multiplier keeps climbing. A fresh spin on fruit slots. High volatility, 5,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.18%, below average.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
